I am Thunchanok, a Master of Business Analytics student at Monash University with a background in accounting. I have a strong interest in data visualisation, data analysis, and storytelling. I enjoy exploring data to find interesting patterns and turning them into clear and engaging stories. This blog is a collection of my data stories and visualisation projects created during my studies. I hope you enjoy reading them as much as I enjoyed creating them!
